name: M.K. Sons Fine Jewels Limited
summary: Mumbai/Ahmedabad retail jeweller (gold, diamond, CZ) with 5 showrooms; ₹275 Cr issue, ~80% fresh.
financials: FY26 revenue ₹539 Cr (+53%), EBITDA ₹83 Cr (15.4%), PAT ₹52 Cr (+123%); P/E ~13.4x at upper band vs peer avg 20.3x.
positives: P/E ~13x vs listed jewellery peers averaging ~20x
Revenue ₹217 Cr to ₹539 Cr and PAT ₹8 Cr to ₹52 Cr in two years
Fresh issue mostly funds a new showroom's inventory and ₹30 Cr debt repayment
red_flags: Growth and margin jump (gross margin 9% to 19%) with the same 5 stores; Q1 EBITDA margin 23%
Inventory days 122 to 333; net operating cycle 321 days
Promoter selling ₹55 Cr via OFS; business only moved into the company in Mar 2025; Mumbai/Ahmedabad concentration
anchor: Anchors ₹82.6 Cr, 9 offshore/small funds, no domestic MFs (weak grade)
